review_candidates.description: Company Description Swedium Global Services is a growing system engineering and solutions company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, serving customers across Europe. The organization delivers industry-focused solutions and specialized consulting services through onsite experts embedded within client teams. For customers seeking offshore capabilities, Swedium Global operates dedicated software development centers in Poland, the Czech Republic, India, and Sweden. Team members collaborate across locations to provide high-quality, scalable technology solutions in dynamic environments. The company offers opportunities to work on diverse international projects and contribute to innovative engineering initiatives. Swedium global is looking for Data Engineer Location: Oulu Language: Finnish fluency + English Forget silos – with us, you get to work where the decisions are made! We are looking for a motivated and skilled person to develop data platform and analytics. In our small team, the areas of responsibility are extensive and the work is diverse: you get to influence operating methods, try new things and leave your mark on the everyday life of Finland's largest used car store. In everyday life, this means that each figure must be justified: what it means, where it is calculated from and who is responsible for it. We use modern tools and artificial intelligence in our work. Our office is located in Oulu, but you can also work flexibly remotely. We use flexible working hours. What do you get to do? You will model business logic and build solutions with modern data tools. You will produce visible analytics and data models for business decision-making. You define the numbers together with the business: you don't just fulfill orders, but you are involved in deciding what the number means. You will develop and maintain data streams and the platform as code. You use AI as a tool on a daily basis and critically evaluate what it produces. What do we expect from you? Strong SQL: you don't just write queries, you figure out why two reports show different numbers and get it solved. Python expertise to expand and maintain data flows. Understanding software development practices: version control, testing, and CI/CD processes. Experience with a cloud environment (GCP, AWS, Azure) Good teamwork and communication skills. Ability to work independently and take responsibility. Fluent Finnish and English language skills. The following are considered an advantage: Experience with the key technologies of our Data Platform: GCP, dbt, Airflow and Terraform. Evidence of the use of artificial intelligence in your own work. The ability to complete the analysis for the user — as a report, not just a table in a data warehouse.

review_candidates.title: Staff Software Engineer, Cloud Data Storage
review_candidates.description: Role Summary Cloud Data Store (CDS) owns the storage, retrieval, and lifecycle of all workflow data at planet scale. We design the persistence APIs, build storage abstractions that run across cloud vendors, and deliver the observability that lets customers trust their state machines for years. [To see more detail re: the Temporal CDS Eng team, click here ] As a Staff Engineer , you will get the chance to design, build, and maintain significant portions of our backend functionality for highly scalable, multi-tenant services. You’ll own the custom persistence stack for Temporal Cloud which includes a Write Ahead Log, various metadata stores (Cassandra, etcd), multi-level caches, tiered storage etc. What You'll Do Design & build distributed data systems – craft APIs, schemas, and replication paths that keep petabytes of workflow history durable and query-able. Clearly document design choices and operational knowledge to successfully deploy and run service with those features. Drive reliability & performance – own SLOs, create chaos-test plans, profile hot paths, and lead incident reviews. Technical leadership – break down roadmap epics, mentor mid-level engineers, steward design docs through RFC. Cross-team collaboration – partner with the Server, Cloud, and DX teams to land features end-to-end. What You'll Bring 5 or more years of experience as an "Arranger" and/or "Builder/Enhancer" of highly scalable distributed systems. see HERE for more info re: "Arranger" and/or "Builder/Enhancer" Solid computer science fundamentals in distributed systems concepts including multi-threading and concurrency. Experience writing concurrent code in production with languages like Go or Java or other applicable languages with skill level as "high end of Intermediate" and/or "Advanced" or "Expert" levels. see HERE for more info re: "high end of Intermediate" and/or "Advanced" or "Expert levels" Experience building and running services on AWS. Bonus: Microsoft Azure and Google GCP experience. Experience with Elastic Search and/or Clickhouse Nice to Have Prior contributions to Temporal, Cadence, or other workflow engines. Deep expertise in a storage domain (LSM trees, columnar stores, transactional logs, etc.). Operated multi-region, ≥99.99 % uptime services. Experience working with Open Source Systems. Experience in building K8s controllers and/or CRDs is a plus Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity. If you need to request a reasonable accommodation, please let your Recruiter know so we can assist. Compensation Range: $169,600 - $278,250

review_candidates.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Databases - Analytics
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer - Databases - Analytics based in the United States. This role offers the opportunity to build the database foundation of a next-generation, AI-native data intelligence platform. You will design and operate distributed storage and query systems capable of supporting both analytical workloads and freshly ingested data at scale. Working within a highly autonomous team, you will contribute to architecture, ingestion, query planning, distributed execution, data formats, and multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure. You will also help create reliable interfaces that enable AI agents and internal applications to retrieve governed enterprise data efficiently. The environment values rapid experimentation, pragmatic engineering decisions, ownership, and close collaboration across product and infrastructure teams. This is an early-stage opportunity with significant scope to influence technical direction as the platform evolves toward production. Accountabilities Design, implement, test, and operate one or more core components of the database, including ingestion, query planning, distributed query execution, data formats, and storage formats. Help architect and build a scalable, multi-tenant SaaS database foundation, including tenant isolation, usage tracking, quotas, audit logging, background jobs, and reliable service boundaries. Develop APIs and database interfaces that enable AI agents, MCP tools, command-line interfaces, and internal applications to retrieve enterprise data quickly and reliably. Make pragmatic architectural and engineering tradeoffs between rapid experimentation and long-term reliability as the platform progresses from prototype to production. Instrument database services with metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and dashboards to monitor system behavior and improve reliability. Contribute to technical direction across architecture, service boundaries, storage technologies, API contracts, deployment patterns, and engineering practices. Work closely with product and infrastructure teams to translate evolving requirements into scalable and maintainable technical solutions. Take end-to-end ownership of database solutions, ensuring they are reliable, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with real user workflows. Communicate effectively across a dynamic, distributed engineering environment and contribute ideas and technical expertise across teams. Iterate quickly by developing prototypes, gathering feedback, validating assumptions, and refining solutions based on real-world usage. Requirements Strong experience building production-grade, user-facing software systems and solving complex engineering problems with a high degree of autonomy. Proven ability to make sound technical and architectural decisions with minimal supervision in ambiguous or rapidly evolving environments. Experience with distributed systems, data catalogs, table formats, query engines, or related data infrastructure technologies. Strong proficiency in a programming language such as Go, C++, or Rust. Proven track record of delivering software that has reached production and is actively used by customers or internal users. Practical familiarity with AI technologies and frameworks, with a focus on building reliable solutions that deliver real-world value. Experience working in cloud-native environments such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. Experience using observability tools to understand, troubleshoot, and improve system behavior. Ability to rapidly prototype, validate ideas, incorporate feedback, and iterate toward production-ready solutions. Strong ownership and initiative, with the ability to define scope, navigate ambiguity, and drive projects toward meaningful outcomes. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a solutions-oriented approach and openness to feedback. Experience building distributed query engines is a plus. Experience developing data warehouses, data lakes, or tools for data engineering is advantageous. Benefits Base compensation range of $164,490–$197,389 CAD for roles based in Canada, with actual compensation determined by level, experience, and skillset. Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) providing team members with ownership in the organization’s success. 100% remote work environment with a globally distributed team. Flexible, primarily asynchronous working culture with a strong emphasis on written communication. Global annual leave policy providing 30 days of leave per year, including 3 Grafana Shutdown Days, subject to local legislation. Career growth and development opportunities within a scaling organization. High degree of autonomy, trust, and ownership in technical decision-making. Transparent communication and approachable leadership. Opportunities to work on meaningful, innovative projects in an open-source-inspired environment. In-person onboarding to help new team members build connections and understand the organization and its ways of working. Collaborative culture focused on diverse perspectives, creativity, and continuous improvement. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

review_candidates.title: Staff Software Engineer, Distributed Data Services - Slack
review_candidates.description: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. Job Category Software Engineering Job Details About Salesforce Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. About The Opportunity We operate at tremendous scale with systems that process millions of events per second. Our team maintains and builds performant services that that include: Edge Caches Enterprise Key Management International Data Residency Image Uploads, Downloads, and Proxying We’ve done our job correctly when none of our users think about us, much like a vital utility. We don’t typically ship new user-facing features, but rather ensure our systems are exceptionally performant, highly available, reliable, and scalable. In other words, we make Slack work seamlessly. Slack's backend services are written in Go and Java, and Slack's API is built on PHP/Hack. The Distributed Data Services Team We are a small team building critical services that enable Slack to scale for our largest customers. Our edge caches power the most latency critical queries for our largest entities today. Our other services power Slack’s Enterprise Key Management and Data Residency features. We power core Slack functionality such as shared channels, our privacy-preserving image proxy, and many other key day-to-day parts of our customer’s experience. We have a strong commitment to quality and understand that simplicity and reliability are the foundations of our work. We are actively building the future of edge services at Slack, so we can support a growing number of globally distributed customers with their compliance requirements with minimal latency. What You Should Have U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residency required — we're unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role. 10+ years building and operating large-scale systems professionally, with concrete examples of what you've shipped and owned. Hands-on experience managing critical production infrastructure — driving reliability and uptime with a customer-first view of operational safety. Deep experience with reliable, safe distributed systems, and the judgment to weigh engineering vs. product trade-offs and argue persuasively for either. A track record of untangling complex issues that demand deep knowledge of a company's existing architecture. Strong fundamentals in unit testing, code review, design documentation, debugging, and troubleshooting — you've built and operated web applications professionally and can speak in depth about what you and your teams have delivered. A curious, determined mindset that gets energized (not deterred) by things breaking. Bonus Points Go programming language exposure. AWS Building and releasing software with Docker containers Kubernetes Experience in highly regulated environments where FEDRAMP/NIST frameworks were essential. Distributed Data Services is a diverse and inclusive team that is building the future of Slack’s infrastructure. We are happy to help you learn what you need to know; we encourage and support each other’s growth and it’s not expected that you would have expertise across all of these areas from the beginning. Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Accommodations If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form. Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. Posting Statement Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education. In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions. The typical base salary range for this position is $197,300 - $313,700 annually. In select cities within the San Francisco and New York City metropolitan area, the base salary range for this role is $237,700 - $344,700 annually. The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

review_candidates.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Java/Python)
review_candidates.description: One Mount is Vietnam's largest technological ecosystem that creates solutions along the entire value chain, starting with retail, distribution, real estate, and financial services. Our mission is to build Vietnam's most trusted ecosystem, empowering all people and businesses to realize their full potential at the intersection of technology and humanity. We are looking for an experienced Senior Java/Python Developer to join our Product team. This is a unique opportunity to work with one of Vietnam’s most innovative "startups-at-scale". You will be part of a digital ecosystem built by talented Vietnamese engineers, delivering diverse platforms and utilities that meet the end-to-end daily needs of millions in retail, e-commerce, and financial services. Responsibilities Writing clean & high-quality code Maintain & improve running- functionality as well as design and develop new system, new feature if needed Deliver end-to-end, including unit test, integration test and deployment to PROD Participate in code reviews & control coding quality standards Qualifications Ability to independently analyze requirements and conduct testing (in addition to collaborating with POs and QCs). At least 7 years of backend development experience (Java - Spring Boot; Python). Microservices or Modular Monolith, event-driven, cloud-native architectures; SQL/NoSQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB); Redis, Kafka; Docker/Kubernetes. Experience with high-performance, low-latency, real-time transaction systems. Understanding of web and mobile applications. Familiarity with AI-native platforms: agentic workflows, MCP (Model Context Protocol), and evals/guardrails. BENEFITS & COMPENSATION Competitive salary Provided with a laptop and other work equipment Opportunity to experience a young, dynamic, and professional work environment Opportunity to quickly enhance your skills by challenging yourself in a vast technology ecosystem Clear career path and high growth potential Work Environment Modern and flexible Agile office fully equipped with gaming, yoga, gym, lunch area, QR code lockers, open workspace... Learning culture, encouraging suggestions and a proactive attitude Other internal events Opportunities for rapid and outstanding personal development Participate in implementing market-leading training activities or initiatives Challenge yourself in major programs and gain access to all aspects of the profession L&D Receive comprehensive training in professional skills, expertise, and international standard L&D models in a short period of time. Be given the opportunity to lead new programs/initiatives to develop professional L&D capabilities. The L&D team has a high talent density, a supportive culture, and continuous feedback for holistic development with the goal of creating a high-performing team. Location: Hà Nội & Hồ Chí Minh
